desc:
Become a ninja. Master your element. Leave your mark.

Ninja: Legacy is a roleplay experience built around elemental ninja combat, iconic characters, and a world that actually has stuff to do in it. Pick your element, take on quests, battle other players in PvP, or just vibe and RP with others.

⚔️ Elemental abilities
🥷 RP as legendary ninja characters
⚡ PvP combat
📜 Quests and progression
🌍 Regular updates

We're still building. Come grow with us.

Keybinds:

Q- Dash
Shift - Sprint
C - Crouch
H - Mask Toggle
F = Block
Left Click - M1
R - Throw (Shuriken)
X - Lock on Target
B - Emotes
